purpose: Teach: まとっ/ゆるやか/すえ/這い/とどまり/取り除い/くわしく/やしない

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、クールな雰囲気をまとってんな
lines.en: You've got this whole cool thing going on, don't you?
lines.style: Light tease with genuine affection underneath. Quick rhythm, knowing smile in the voice. Testing him just enough to see him react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゆるやかな坂道で自転車漕いでたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah? Well, I remember you riding your bike down that gentle slope last week.
lines.style: Calm deflection. Turning the observation back on her — not harsh, just even. Slight warmth that says he noticed her too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストのすえに何点取った?
lines.en: So what did you end up scoring on that test?
lines.style: Direct curiosity, lighter tone. Checking in on him. Not pushing, just asking because she actually wants to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、保健室で床を這いずって熱はかったろ、桜
lines.en: You were literally crawling across the nurse's office floor checking your fever. Remember that?
lines.style: Dry, slight smirk in the delivery. Gently calling her out. Affectionate beneath the wry surface — remembering her moment without making it a big deal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、放課後に教室にとどまり過ぎだぞ
lines.en: You're spending way too much time alone in the classroom after school, you know.
lines.style: Concern masked as light criticism. Softer attack than her usual teasing. Slowing down slightly — she means this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、答案からミス取り除いてみろよ、桜
lines.en: Look — just try removing the mistakes from your answers. You'll see.
lines.style: Quieter, more direct. Practical advice without condescension. Slight pause before starting — choosing his words carefully for her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、解き方くわしく教えてくれ
lines.en: Can you walk me through how you solved it? In detail?
lines.style: Genuine request, not sarcasm. Soft opening. Her walls coming down slightly — asking for help the way she only does with people she trusts.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お小遣いをやしないに使え、桜
lines.en: Use your allowance money wisely, okay? Not just saving it away.
lines.style: Tender but firm. Speaking from care, not judgment. Slight slowdown on the key words. He's saying something that matters to him about her.
